caption: Oslo-guide: Spend a day in Majorstuen; a cute, central and less touristy spot in Oslo!📍 🛍️ad Go shopping at @Moniker in @VALKYRIEN OSLO, where you can find lots of Scandinavian and luxury brands! Clothes, accessories & interior for men and women 💖 🏘️Some of the cutest streets in Oslo, is located around Majorstuen. Some of my favorites are Jacob Aals gate & Sorgenfrigata. ☕️ Finally, go for a coffee at a super-local cafe; Havens Café. Their coffees and matchas are delicious, and they also serve the best desserts (which are also gluten free?!). Across the street, you can also visit their little shop, with international delicacies!  💖 Save this for your next trip to Oslo!  #oslotips #guide #recommendation #cafe #shopping
